authority_limit: Rust traits encode type-level interface obligations; they do not by themselves express domain laws, effects, total failures, resource bounds or conformance evidence.
bounded_claim: Rust traits define abstract interfaces through functions, types and constants implemented for concrete types; associated declarations form the type-level contract available to generic code.

authority_limit: WIT describes component interfaces and bindings, not business semantics, algebraic laws, provider quality or end-to-end behavior.
bounded_claim: WIT expresses typed imports, exports, resources and worlds that can serve as language-neutral component port boundaries.

authority_limit: The paper proves convergence under explicit assumptions; it does not make arbitrary merges semantically valid or establish application invariants, authorization or loss acceptance.
bounded_claim: CRDT convergence follows only for defined state- or operation-based designs satisfying their stated algebraic and delivery assumptions.

authority_limit: Covers mediation between stream components; it does not define transformations, business ordering, durability, exactly-once effects or all runtime resource policies.
bounded_claim: Reactive Streams specifies asynchronous sequenced exchange with mandatory non-blocking backpressure and supplies a TCK for encoded interoperability rules.

authority_limit: Defines an HTTP representation for interface problems, not an internal exception model, retry policy, root cause, compensation result or universal domain refusal catalog.
bounded_claim: RFC 9457 distinguishes a reusable machine-readable problem type from a URI-identifiable problem occurrence at an HTTP boundary.

authority_limit: A model proves only encoded properties within its abstraction and assumptions; it does not prove implementation refinement, environment behavior or product fitness without further evidence.
bounded_claim: TLA+ specifications separate initial states, next-state behavior, safety and liveness, making system assumptions and properties explicit at the model level.

authority_limit: Provenance records origins and relations; it does not establish truth, authorization, causal sufficiency, integrity or acceptance.
bounded_claim: PROV-O represents provenance relations among entities, activities and agents and can be specialized for domain interchange.

authority_limit: Methodological guidance cannot make an underspecified requirement testable or prove completeness of a test suite or implementation.
bounded_claim: Testable conformance begins with precise normative requirements whose subjects, conditions and required behavior can be mapped to implementation-independent tests.

authority_limit: Random testing finds counterexamples under generators and seeds; passing tests is not a universal proof and properties can reproduce specification mistakes.
bounded_claim: QuickCheck turns executable properties and generators into reproducible randomized tests and shrinks failures toward smaller counterexamples.

authority_limit: Telemetry is sampled and pipeline-dependent observation; it does not by itself prove causality, completeness, business outcome, conformance or absence of failure.
bounded_claim: OpenTelemetry defines distinct trace, metric and log signals with shared context/resource conventions and pluggable processing/export pipelines.
